author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam visits effects master Greg Nicotero at KNB EFX's workshop to dive into his storied history of creating makeup and practical special effects for films and television. From their award-winning work on The Chronicles of Narnia to collaborating with Quentin Tarantino and creating the zombie designs for The Walking Dead, here's how Nicotero and his team have kept pushing the boundaries of makeup, prosthetics, and animatronics for nearly 40 years. 

Learn more about KNB EFX's work at https://www.knbefx.com/

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy KNB EFX Group
